sources.articleTitle: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says

headline: US, Russia, and China Leaders to Hold Joint Talks at APEC Summit
seoTitle: US, Russia, China Leaders to Meet at APEC
metaDescription: President Donald Trump is scheduled to meet with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping during the upcoming APEC summit in Shenzhen, China next week.
aiSummaryBullets: President Donald Trump is traveling to Shenzhen, China, to attend the 21-member APEC summit.
The White House confirmed plans for a meeting between the leaders of the US, Russia, and China.
A bilateral discussion between President Trump and President Xi Jinping is also scheduled during the visit.
aiContextParagraph: The White House has announced that President Donald Trump, President Vladimir Putin, and President Xi Jinping are slated to participate in a joint meeting during the upcoming Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. The event is scheduled to take place in Shenzhen, China, next week. According to official reports, President Trump will arrive in the city on Wednesday for the two-day gathering, which includes representatives from all 21 member nations. In addition to the trilateral focus, President Trump is expected to conduct a bilateral meeting with President Xi Jinping on Thursday. This engagement marks their fourth meeting since President Trump resumed office in 2025. The summit serves as a significant diplomatic platform for leaders from these three nations to engage in dialogue amid ongoing international relations. The White House has framed the planned discussions as a notable event on the sidelines of the broader regional summit.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained attention due to the high-profile nature of the three leaders involved and the strategic importance of the upcoming summit.
